opening.argument: Forsage is presented as a money-oriented matrix in which participants buy ETH-denominated slots, and the narration ties positions filled by invited partners to wallet payouts. It says higher-priced slots bring higher income, recommends starting with three slots in both programs for 0.35 ETH, and urges participants to recommend the same approach to their partners. A displayed progression table pairs increasing ETH amounts with a stated return of 1430 ETH, or 350,000 dollars. Together, these are claims of recruitment-linked commissions and tiered returns that support the position that this is a scam. The records do not independently verify those figures or establish that any payment was completed.

citations.quote: Forsage marketing is a classic matrix that is the most effective system in terms of money.
When you invite partners they take places under you.
The most balanced option for the majority is to start with 3 slots of both programs at once. The entry amount is 0.35 ETH, which is not too much and not too small.
